sections.title: Practical instruments for the officer who has to ship the next quarter.
sections.subtitle: Planning frameworks, disaster toolkits, and monitoring tools — each designed for adoption, not admiration. Use them, adapt them, share back what you learnt.
sections.imageAlt: Officers reviewing planning templates on a table

sections.title: Adapt first, adopt later.
body: Every template here is field-tested but locally adapted before it works for you. We recommend three steps: read the design notes, run a one-week pilot with a single team, and only then institutionalise.
If you can't find the toolkit you need — write to us. Where we have it, we'll share. Where we don't, we'll help you draft one.

sections.title: From idea to implementation plan
sections.subtitle: The everyday toolkit for designing public-sector initiatives that can actually be delivered.

items.title: Model Project Template
items.description: A structured project canvas with built-in evaluation metrics, risk register, and stakeholder map. Used as the first artefact in every new initiative — before the procurement, before the launch.

items.title: Mission Mode Framework
items.description: Go/no-go criteria, mission leader job description, cross-functional team composition, and the cadence that turns a department goal into a time-bound mission.

items.title: Real-Time Governance Tracker
items.description: A dashboard template (Power BI / Google Sheets) for tracking scheme performance at district and panchayat level. Includes definitions and refresh-cadence guidance.

items.title: Citizen Charter Generator
items.description: Department-by-department citizen charter starter pack — with SLA defaults, redressal flow, and a structure for public publication. Designed to be short enough to actually be read.

sections.title: Don't improvise — pre-position
sections.subtitle: Toolkits derived from Kerala Rescue, Covid Jagrata and other field operations — to be adapted, drilled, and made local.

items.title: Kerala Rescue ops framework
items.description: Volunteer engineering pod, moderation desk, SOS triage and camp coordination playbook — derived from the 2018 floods.

items.title: Covid Jagrata model protocol
items.description: Integrated public-health command stack — testing, quarantine, hospital bed and vaccine modules — with Reverse Quarantine playbook.

items.title: Emergency incident response SOPs
items.description: Generic incident response SOPs — activation, roles, decision rights, and communication patterns — adaptable to fire, flood, accident, communal.

sections.title: The cadence is the system
sections.subtitle: Tools for keeping departments and field teams accountable to each other, week after week.

items.title: e-Dooth field coordination model
items.description: A simple field-officer coordination protocol — beat plans, daily standups, weekly aggregation — for any cadre with a geographically dispersed footprint.

items.title: SDOT optimisation toolkit
items.description: Service delivery optimisation toolkit — for diagnosing bottlenecks, redesigning queues, and reducing citizen wait time at high-traffic offices.

items.title: Panchayat & district dashboards
items.description: Indicator definitions, refresh cadence, and review-meeting templates for panchayat-level and district-level governance dashboards.

sections.title: Have a tool to share?
sections.body: If you've built or used a tool that works in the field, we'd love to publish it (with credit). Surajyapatham is a library, not a library card — the value compounds when officers share what they have built.

sections.title: Using these tools in your district

items.question: Are these tools free to use?
items.answer: Yes. Every template on Surajyapatham is free to use and adapt for public-sector work. Where appropriate, we ask for attribution and a learning-back loop.

items.question: Can I get help adapting a tool to my context?
items.answer: Yes — write to us through the Contact page. We try to match officers with peers who have used the same tool, or with the original team where possible.

items.question: Do you certify or train officers in these tools?
items.answer: Some tools have associated training modules in the Learning Hub. For others, we run on-request webinars and peer-mentoring sessions.

sections.title: Need a toolkit built for your district?
sections.subtitle: Tell us the problem you are trying to solve — we'll either point you to an existing toolkit, or help you co-create one.
